title: Rules (M5)
brief: Rules screen of goop (/rules): what the Learner agent (ACE-style playbook) learned from your dismiss reasons, saves, applies and chat corrections. Two groups, To review (proposed, not active, yellow count) and Active (paused rules muted); each row has the rule in plain English, where it came from, its effect this week and a state tag. The selected rule expands with goop's reason and the offers that triggered it. Key hints: enter accept (primary, green, on a proposed rule), e edit, p pause, x delete, t test on today's offers, esc back, ? all actions. Status line with the rules focus mode. Below the screen: edit in place, the test result and the toast after accept.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Consistent with M2 and M10, rules scan as columns and you accept with the evidence in view; hides the chat and shows the evidence of one rule at a time
